name: azure-devops
description: Azure DevOps for Claude Code via Microsoft's official @azure-devops/mcp server: repos, files, pull requests, pipelines/builds, work items, wiki, test plans. Auth via the Azure CLI (az login / DefaultAzureCredential) — no PAT baked into config. Local git PR checkout/push uses Claude Code's native git tools.
